verdicts.note: Open seat, so not an incumbent. But she has 19 years in the Auditor's office and 11 as Elections Administrator, and promises 'a smooth and effective transition' [S1][S2]. That is a continuity profile and -1 medium fits. Her 'accountability, and transparent leadership' line [S1] is about office conduct and correctly does not support a reform score.

Tested toward -1 (insider) and toward +1 (shorter tenure). She has about five years as a deputy in the same office [S4], an elected Ritzville School Board seat and eight years of management outside government [S1]. She does not run as a change candidate. 0 for a genuinely mixed profile holds at medium.

She pledges to use technology to 'streamline operations, reduce costs' [S1] and to 'be a careful steward of taxpayer dollars' [S3], and her site adds performance tracking against 'the standards taxpayers expect' [S2]. That is pole_a (audit and restrain). The statements are about office efficiency, not a broad restraint program, so -1 rather than -2. S1 and S3 support the basis.
